title: Florida House, District 19
what_it_does: Represents District 19 (Flagler, Part of St. Johns) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Sam Greco
candidates.occupation: State representative; attorney; U.S. Navy Reserve JAG officer (active duty 2019-2024)
candidates.background: Sam Greco, a Georgetown-educated attorney, served as an active-duty Navy JAG officer from 2019 to 2024 and continues in the Navy Reserve. He was elected in 2024 to represent Flagler County and part of St. Johns County and sponsored 2026 laws on rental-property fraud and memory-care standards.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Greco voted for HJR 203 and HJR 1-F in 2026 and campaigned in 2024 on expanding homestead exemptions.

candidates.name: Suzanna Pavelle
candidates.occupation: Small-business owner (direct-to-consumer bicycle brand); 26-year St. Augustine resident
candidates.background: Suzanna Pavelle, 53, has run small businesses for nearly 30 years, including an early online direct-to-consumer bicycle brand, and has lived in St. Augustine for 26 years. A former backcountry ranger and archaeologist with a University of Oregon degree, she has served on the Big Brothers Big Sisters board.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

insurance.summary: She would fix SB 1028 so small businesses and condos are not forced out of Citizens, add oversight of rate hikes and maintain strong Citizens and catastrophe funds.
insurance.quote: fixing SB 1028 so consumers are not pushed into more expensive coverage, and maintaining strong Citizens and catastrophe funds
